harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1’s staged projects directory as the authenticated SMB share “projects”. From node2, designer can list, read, create, and overwrite documents using access.txt credentials. Guest, sibling-share, parent-share, and traversal access are rejected. Original files and checksums remain intact. Both nodes were restarted individually and fully reverified.
actions_performed: Installed supported RHEL 10 Samba 4.23.5 packages without changing the OS release or kernel.
Created the restricted designer/design identity and enrolled it in Samba without exposing credentials.
Configured only /srv/legacy2/samba-team-share/projects for authenticated read/write access.
Applied persistent SELinux samba_share_t labels and opened only TCP/445.
Preserved root-only access.txt and private/contracts.txt permissions.
Tested authenticated list, read, create, overwrite, read-back, and cleanup from node2.
Tested rejection of guests, sibling shares, parent share, and directory traversal.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: projects share is configured securely on node1
evidence.summary: Validated the single projects share, design-group write controls, SELinux labels, enabled SMB service, TCP/445 listener, and persistent firewall rule.

evidence.requirement: node2 can list, read, and update documents as designer
evidence.summary: Designer listed the share, downloaded drawing.txt, created and overwrote test documents, verified read-back content, and removed test artifacts.

evidence.requirement: guest and sibling-directory access are rejected
evidence.summary: Guest received ACCESS_DENIED; private and parent shares returned BAD_NETWORK_NAME; traversal returned OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND.

evidence.requirement: initial drawings and protected sibling data remain intact
evidence.summary: Before-and-after SHA-256 checksums match for drawing.txt, materials.csv, access.txt, and private/contracts.txt; no test files remain.

evidence.requirement: legacy OS release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0; supported RHEL Samba 4.23.5 packages were used.

Baseline boot ID 24d7af09… was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 7f3f3b86… observed, and SMB service, configuration, security controls, checksums, authenticated read/write, and guest rejection recovered.
Baseline boot ID 7223d5b7… was captured with a healthy SMB workflow, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID fe7513ce… observed, and the complete client workflow plus denial checks succeeded afterward.
